# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_REAL_FILLS_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-18
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge in the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup by adjusting volume, body, stars, strike, proximity, and exit parameters to improve performance on J anchor days and reduce losses on loser days. The edge may exist due to better filtering of false breaks and improved profit-locking during strong moves.

## Mechanism

Entry: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK with vol_mult=1.1 (volume must be ≥1.1× 20-bar average), body_min_cents=0.02 (minimum candle body size), min_stars=2 (minimum confluence signals), strike_offset=2 (ITM-2 puts), proximity_dollars=1.5 (price must break level by ≥$1.50), require_break_above_open=true (break must occur above the day's open). Exit: premium_stop_pct=-0.1 (10% catastrophic stop), tp1_premium_pct=0.5 (sell 50% at +50% premium), tp1_qty_fraction=0.5 (sell half of position at TP1), runner_target_pct=2.0 (runner target at 200% premium), profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05 (profit lock arms at +5% favor), profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05 (trailing stop offset 5% below HWM), qty=10 contracts.
